content:
Let \(a=9k+8\). The mod \(3\) condition is automatically satisfied because \(9k+8\equiv 2\pmod 3\).

Now impose mod \(5\):
\[
9k+8\equiv 4k+3\equiv 4\pmod 5
\]
\[
4k\equiv 1\pmod 5 \implies k\equiv 4\pmod 5.
\]
So \(k=5m+4\), giving
\[
a=9(5m+4)+8=45m+44.
\]

Now impose mod \(7\):
\[
45m+44\equiv 3m+2\equiv 6\pmod 7
\]
\[
3m\equiv 4\pmod 7 \implies m\equiv 6\pmod 7.
\]
So \(m=7n+6\), giving
\[
a=45(7n+6)+44=315n+314.
\]

The smallest non-negative value occurs at \(n=0\):
\[
\boxed{314}
\]
